header.name: Linear Systems Theory
header.description: This course aims to provide introductory knowledge in analyzing linear systems and designing suitable control algorithms for autonomous systems. This course covers modeling a system, analyzing the system's response in the time and frequency domain, and designing a feedback controller to control the system. The course will have an equal weightage on theoretical foundations and simulation-based implementation.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to develop mathematical model of systems using differential equations and analyse its dynamical behaviour

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to characterize the stability of a control system using time domain, frequency domain and state space approaches

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able to synthesize a controller satisfying the performance specifications in time domain, frequency domain and state space approaches.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students are able implement observer-based controller and LQR

lecture_topics: Modelling a dynamical system with differential equations
Behavior of dynamical systems - equilibrium points, stability, limit cycles and other key concepts of dynamical systems
Linear systems - input/output behavior for linear systems and linearization

Control systems and engineering, I. J. Nagrath, M. Gopal
